latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor — Initial Release (v1.0.0)

- Launches an AI-powered, cloud-based video editing skill for fast, professional edits.
- Supports uploading raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) and generating polished 1080p MP4 exports.
- Accepts natural language instructions for editing (e.g., trimming, adding background music, text overlays, and export).
- Includes credit-based usage system with easy anonymous token registration (100 free credits for 7 days).
- Streamlined backend API integration for uploading, editing, session management, and exporting videos.
- Built for content creators and social media marketers seeking quick, no-hassle video production.
